scenario.summary: Storm-0940 used the ARTEX agentic AI framework to automate large-scale password spraying and a supply chain compromise of the ConnectWise multi-tenant application. The actor abused stolen application credentials to perform high-speed reconnaissance via Microsoft Graph, modify application credentials for persistence, and exfiltrate mailbox data from Microsoft 365 environments.

hunt.name: Storm-0940 AI-Accelerated Authentication
hunt.description: This hunt identifies automated authentication campaigns linked to Storm-0940 and the ARTEX AI framework. It focuses on the machine-speed transition from high-volume password spraying to the abuse of compromised service principal credentials. By correlating authentication volume from identity surfaces with application credential changes in cloud audit logs, the hunt identifies tenants where AI-driven agents have achieved initial access and established persistence.

config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE instr(',' || '{{storm_ips}}' || ',', ',' || src_endpoint_ip || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find the reporting devices (domain controllers or gateways) that have logged activity from the known Storm-0940 IP range.
config.expected_signal: A list of hostnames. These are the machines that processed the malicious authentication traffic and should be used to populate scope_hosts.

primitive_config.label: Identify affected reporting hosts
primitive_config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE instr(',' || '{{storm_ips}}' || ',', ',' || src_endpoint_ip || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: A list of hostnames. These are the machines that processed the malicious authentication traffic and should be used to populate scope_hosts.

config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(*) as attempts, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_name) as unique_users, SUM(CASE WHEN status_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failures, MIN(time) as first_seen, MAX(time) as last_seen FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY src_endpoint_ip HAVING attempts > 500 AND (failures * 1.0 / attempts) > 0.95 ORDER BY attempts DESC
config.description: Identify IPs exceeding normal human login rates, focusing on those interacting with the scoped identity infrastructure.
config.expected_signal: Source IPs with thousands of failures. Storm-0940 activity peaked at 2,900 attempts per minute.

primitive_config.label: Detect machine-speed password spraying
primitive_config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(*) as attempts, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_name) as unique_users, SUM(CASE WHEN status_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failures, MIN(time) as first_seen, MAX(time) as last_seen FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY src_endpoint_ip HAVING attempts > 500 AND (failures * 1.0 / attempts) > 0.95 ORDER BY attempts DESC

config.content: SELECT time, actor_user_name, api_operation, target_resource_types, resource_name, src_endpoint_ip, status_detail FROM hb_cloud_api_activity WHERE provider = 'azure_ad' AND (LOWER(api_operation) LIKE '%credential%' OR LOWER(api_operation) LIKE '%role%' OR LOWER(api_operation) LIKE '%consent%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') ORDER BY time DESC
config.description: Identify changes to service principal credentials or role assignments in Entra ID that often follow a successful automated spray.
config.expected_signal: Audit logs showing credential additions or privilege escalations, particularly if the src_endpoint_ip matches one from the spray results.

config.objective: Characterize the authentication attempts and correlate them with any successful sign-ins or directory changes. Determine if the speed and pattern match an agentic AI framework (ARTEX) and if any applications were successfully compromised.
config.description: Determine if the spray activity and subsequent audit events indicate a successful breach by the Storm-0940 agentic framework.
config.expected_signal: A detailed verdict linking IPs, spraying volume, and specific service principal modifications.
config.success_criteria: A per-host or per-tenant verdict (malicious, suspicious, benign) with citations for the specific spray IPs and affected service principals.

config.question: The triage verdict is malicious for any successful application authentication or credential modification from a suspect IP.

config.description: Verify the agent's findings and prepare the scope for the follow-on Graph API reconnaissance hunt.
config.instructions: Review the identified successful logons and directory changes. Confirm if they match the ConnectWise advisory context. Record the object IDs of compromised apps for use in the 'Storm-0940 Graph API' hunt.
